page.notes: Arabic script is printed in a small, slightly blurred face; the Arabic words are transcribed as best read and may contain errors, especially in the line beginning "ان للخلق" and the long Arabic phrases on the second and third lines of the first paragraph. The bracket after "Merdad" and after "esse" marks variant readings in the printed text; no footnote text is printed for them. The margin note "c. de Nodamianis." may read "Nodamianis" or similar. Printed spelling "Alcoranum", "Monachus" and "Al Mawakef" left as printed. The Latin "Ita certe" and "Eo processit" lines follow the printed lineation.
